metadata.title: शालिमार आदिवासी बाज़ार | Shalimar adivasi Bazar
metadata.description: Weekly markets or bazaars are an integral part of life in tribal India. These markets are the place where tribals not only participate in economic activities, but these are the places for them to socialise also. Such bazaars also become bridges between the tribals living in cities who want to be connected to their roots. we visited one such bazaar near Ranchi, Jharkhand.
